classification.difficultyReason: Complete several mutually consistent opposite side/angle labels.

content.prompt: Label the missing sides and angles of these triangles.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 2a; student labels established by Word image9.png
spec.description: Light-blue triangle outline with left, upper-middle and lower-right vertices. Only B above the top vertex, C outside the lower-right vertex and a outside the right edge are shown.
spec.mathematics: Given B, C and side a=BC. A, b and c are student responses. No angle arcs.

answer.short: $A$ at the left vertex; $b$ on $AC$; $c$ on $AB$.
answer.worked: $A$ is opposite $a$; $b$ is opposite $B$; $c$ is opposite $C$.

spec.description: Same light-blue triangle; all three vertex labels and all three side labels outside the figure in darker blue.
spec.mathematics: A at left, B at top, C at lower right; a=BC, b=AC, c=AB.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 2b; student labels established by Word image11.png
spec.description: Light-blue triangle with horizontal base and apex left of the midpoint. Only B at lower right, a below the base and c outside the right slope are shown.
spec.mathematics: Given B, side a=BC and side c=AB. A, C and b are student responses. No arcs.

answer.short: $A$ at the top; $C$ at the lower left; $b$ on $AC$.
answer.worked: $A$ is opposite $a$; $C$ is opposite $c$; $b$ is opposite $B$.

spec.description: Same light-blue triangle with all vertex and side labels outside the figure in darker blue.
spec.mathematics: A at top, B at lower right, C at lower left; a=BC, b=AC, c=AB.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 2c; student labels established by Word image13.png
spec.description: Larger elongated saturated-blue triangle, lower left to upper right, with an intermediate lower-right vertex. Only Q at upper right, R below the intermediate vertex and p outside QR are shown.
spec.mathematics: Given Q, R and side p=QR. P, q and r are student responses. No angle arcs.

answer.short: $P$ at the lower left; $q$ on $PR$; $r$ on $PQ$.
answer.worked: $P$ is opposite $p$; $q$ is opposite $Q$; $r$ is opposite $R$.

spec.description: Same larger saturated-blue triangle with P, Q, R and p, q, r outside their corresponding vertices and edges.
spec.mathematics: P at lower left, Q at upper right, R at intermediate lower vertex; p=QR, q=PR, r=PQ.
